options_sync_guide_step1.message: To synchronize your templates across multiple computers without permissions:

options_sync_guide_step2.message: 1. Export your templates and save the JSON file to your Google Drive folder.

options_sync_guide_step3.message: 2. On your other computer, open FluxSnip options and import the JSON file from the Drive folder.

options_sync_guide_step4.message: 3. Choose 'Merge' mode to safely incorporate updates.
